changes.summary: Every method ends with a short carry-forward block to paste into a new chat, so free plans last longer: one stage per chat.

Methods are served only by the ARS connector (no downloads). HEC references re-checked on hec.gov.pk: the GenAI framework edition on HEC's site (2026) and the Anti-Plagiarism Policy 2023 v2.0. Every report labels claims Verified, Provisional or Not checked, and saves as Saved, Generated but not saved, or Save failed. Topic check shows an eight-check table; fixed report file names in notes/.

The connector now serves the latest method: ARS prompts and get_method load the newest skill text, so connecting ARS is enough. Skills check for a workspace folder or repository at the start and can create the workspace. New log option for chats that can create files.

Skills keep logs/ and the disclosure draft up to date and check for newer versions; workspace pack adds logs/ and notes/; connector adds kit_status, exact-phrase counts and a shared Semantic Scholar limiter.
First release for the CUST seminar: four skills, ARS connector, workspace pack.
